verification_candidates.claim_text: The prescribed medications people take for ADD and ADHD are stimulants.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: You can be taking all of these prescribed medications for ADD, ADHD, and they are stimulants.
verification_candidates.rationale: A classification of a whole drug class that can be checked against pharmacology.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Using any stimulant drug taxes the adrenal glands into pumping out more cortisol until they eventually fail, leaving a low cortisol state and all-day fatigue.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: So when you're using any kind of drug, stimulant drug, you're going to start taxing your adrenals to pump out more cortisol and eventually they will fail.
verification_candidates.rationale: A causal harm claim about stimulants and adrenal failure that can be checked against endocrinology.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Stimulants disturb your blood sugar.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: It's also going to start messing with your blood sugar.
verification_candidates.rationale: A causal claim about stimulants and glucose regulation that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: People who say they need Adderall in order to function are literally addicted to a stimulant.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Yeah, your body is literally addicted to a stimulant to just get through your day.
verification_candidates.rationale: A diagnostic claim about prescribed stimulant users that could change whether they keep taking a prescription.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Weaning off a stimulant puts you through deep exhaustion and bad fatigue.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: You're going to go through some deep exhaustion, some bad fatigue times, but you have to to reset your system.
verification_candidates.rationale: A claim about withdrawal effects that can be checked against clinical evidence.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Continued stimulant use eventually taxes the cardiovascular system and shuts down the adrenals.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: I mean, eventually it's going to start taxing your cardiovascular system.
verification_candidates.rationale: A serious harm claim about stimulant use that can be checked against cardiovascular evidence.

verification_candidates.claim_text: When stimulants and stress overtax the adrenal glands, the glands take progesterone and pregnenolone to make cortisol, so those two hormones drop.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: they stop producing proper amounts of cortisol, they start stealing progesterone and pregnenolone to make the cortisol.
verification_candidates.rationale: A stated hormonal mechanism (pregnenolone steal) that can be checked against endocrinology.

verification_candidates.claim_text: If your cortisol is very low you cannot take T3, because adding T3 gives you heart palpitations and anxiety.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: You actually get heart palpitations and anxiety when you add in T3.
verification_candidates.rationale: A drug-interaction claim about thyroid hormone that patients could act on.

verification_candidates.claim_text: A couple of cups of coffee a day is fine.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: I mean, a couple cups of coffee is fine.
verification_candidates.rationale: A safety threshold for caffeine intake that can be checked against evidence.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Drinking Four Sigmatic reduces your caffeine load.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Do some Four Sigmatic to reduce the caffeine load.
verification_candidates.rationale: A product claim about lowering caffeine intake that can be checked against what the product contains.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Addison's disease is a rarer, diagnosable autoimmune disorder in which the adrenal glands do not produce enough cortisol.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: But Addison's is an actual disorder, a diagnosable disorder that occurs when the adrenal glands just they don't produce enough cortisol.
verification_candidates.rationale: A description of a named disease and its cause that can be checked against medical sources.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Low cortisol is normally caused by people taxing their adrenals through long-term stress and stimulant use rather than by disease.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Normally, when we see low cortisol, it's from what I just talked about.
verification_candidates.rationale: A claim about the usual cause of a lab finding that can be checked against clinical evidence.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The mitochondria are the powerhouse of the cell and are where ATP, the body's energy, is produced.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: So the mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell.
verification_candidates.rationale: A basic physiological claim underpinning the supplement advice that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The T2 supplement Thyroid Fixer works at the mitochondrial level to raise cellular ATP energy.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Now, you've heard me talk about T2, thyroid fixer, and how it actually works at the mitochondrial level to kick up those cells a notch
verification_candidates.rationale: A specific mechanism claim for a named supplement that needs evidence checking.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Raising ATP production improves your metabolism, and low ATP production gives you a low metabolism.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: If you have low ATP production, you're going to have a low metabolism.
verification_candidates.rationale: A causal claim linking cellular energy to metabolic rate that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: There is not really a way to test your ATP production.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: I mean, there's not really a way to test that.
verification_candidates.rationale: A claim about the availability of a test, which can be checked and which licenses treating by symptoms alone.

verification_candidates.claim_text: CoQ10 and L-carnitine supplements improve mitochondrial function.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: There are other supplements that you can add in to improve mitochondrial function.
verification_candidates.rationale: An efficacy claim for named supplements that can be checked against trials.

verification_candidates.claim_text: NADH is the ingredient in Young Goose skin care products, and NAD+ can also be taken as an injectable peptide.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: That's what's in Young Goose Skin Care products, but you can also take NAD plus as an injectable peptide.
verification_candidates.rationale: A composition and route-of-administration claim that can be checked against the products.

verification_candidates.claim_text: You cannot really absorb or make NAD from taking an oral supplement.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: that you can't really absorb or make NAD from...
verification_candidates.rationale: A bioavailability claim about NAD supplements, relayed from others, that can be checked.
